subject: FinLytics post-demo: budget range, token profile & multi-phase discount ask
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: FinLytics post-demo: budget range, token profile & multi-phase discount ask

Hi Olivia / Samir —

Great to meet the FinLytics team on the demo today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can model an accurate pricing path: 

1) Expected token profile (monthly):
   - Search / embeddings: 10M–40M tokens/month (low latency, high qps)
   - Generation (summaries / assistants): 30M–150M tokens/month (spiky)
   - Peak qps: bursts up to ~1k reqs/min (short sequences)

2) Budget range: you mentioned a pilot budget between $8k–$20k/month; please confirm if that’s intended as the steady-state or just the first 3–6 months.

3) Target unit economics: you said "target us <$45 per 1M tokens" in the call — can you confirm whether that target applies to blended tokens or just generation tokens?

4) Program asks: are you looking to qualify for our Startup Founders credit (first 6 months partial offset) or pursuing a committed-use discount / 12–24 month agreement with tiered pricing? If the latter, we typically model committed bands and a multi-year rebate for predictable volume.

What I can do next for you:
- Send a worked pricing workbook with 3 scenarios (pilot, steady-state conservative, growth) showing $/1M token and monthly spend.
- Draft a 12-month committed-use term sheet with a founders credit overlay for months 1–6.

Attachments: I’ll send the workbook and a template term PDF in the follow-up.

Next steps: if you can reply with confirmed monthly token ranges (low / expected / high) and which program you prefer (startup credit vs committed-use), I’ll turn around a formal quote by Tuesday.

Thanks —

Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0132

Redwood Inference — inference engineered for production
From: Olivia Zhang <olivia@finlytics.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finlytics.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinLytics post-demo: budget range, token profile & multi-phase discount ask

Michael —

Thanks for the clear recap, and apologies for the delay. Quick answers below: 

1) Token ranges (monthly):
   - Low: ~50M total tokens/month (search + embeddings + small generation)
   - Expected: ~180M total tokens/month (this is our likely 6–12 month steady state)
   - High: ~420M total tokens/month (if we roll out additional features in Q2)

2) Budget: pilot months 1–3 we can spend up to $10k/month. For steady-state we’re targeting $18k–$28k/month depending on unit price.

3) Target: the <$45 per 1M tokens target was our internal blended target; generation is more costly for us, but the blended target is what matters to finance.

4) Program preference: we’d prefer the committed-use path if it gets us to the blended target — willing to consider a 12-month commit with an option to extend to 24 months pending usage. Also interested in a founders/startup overlay if Redwoods offers an initial credit to help ramp.

Notes: procurement will expect a simple committed PO/contract and a clear banded pricing table (bands by monthly token volume). We can share an internal headcount/feature roll-out timeline if that helps with forecasting.

Best,
Olivia Zhang
Head of Product, FinLytics
olivia@finlytics.ai | +1 646-555-0199
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinLytics post-demo: budget range, token profile & multi-phase discount ask

Thanks Olivia — this is super helpful. I’ve attached the pricing workbook with three scenarios and a draft committed-use template (PDF). High level proposal (summary):

- Pilot (months 0–3): founders offset of 25% credit on usage up to $30k total credit to ease ramp.
- Committed-use banding (12-month):
   - Band A: 0–75M tokens/month -> base rate $85 per 1M tokens
   - Band B: 75M–250M tokens/month -> base rate $55 per 1M tokens
   - Band C: 250M+ tokens/month -> base rate $38 per 1M tokens
- Effective blended target (example at 180M/month): ~ $48 per 1M tokens after a 12-month 20% committed discount applied to the base table.
- Multi-year incentive: option for a year-2 rebate (10% back on year-1 committed spend if we hit agreed growth milestones).

I attached: finlytics_pricing_workbook.xlsx (scenario tabs + burn chart) and redwood_commit_template_v2.pdf (commercial terms + SLAs).

Next steps:
1) Confirm which committed band(s) you want modeled as the baseline for the 12-month term (I used Band B as the likely anchor).
2) If procurement is good with the template, I’ll send a DocuSign link and we can align on purchase order cadence and invoicing.
3) If you’d like, we can run a short eval with quantized model variants to validate cost/latency tradeoffs before signing.

Ben/Marissa — flagging SLA expectations and potential one-off latency SLO notes for the FinLytics use case (search + embeddings high-qps).

Thanks —

Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinLytics post-demo: budget range, token profile & multi-phase discount ask

Noted — I’ll review SLA items and confirm whether we need an SLA exception for sub-100ms tail latency on embeddings. If so, we’ll add a short appendix to the commit template.

Ben Carter
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Zhang <olivia@finlytics.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finlytics.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinLytics post-demo: budget range, token profile & multi-phase discount ask

Michael —

This looks good and aligned with what procurement expects. We’re happy to proceed with a 12-month commit anchored at Band B (75M–250M/month) with the founders offset for months 1–3 (we can cap credits to the pilot budget). Please send the final quote + DocuSign and I’ll loop procurement. Also please include the year-2 rebate language you mentioned — procurement wants that explicitly called out.

Olivia
